# Suchakree "Petch" Chueluecha

## About Me

I am a sixth-year PhD candidate in Mathematics at the University of Virginia, 
working under the supervision of Jennifer Morse. I am currently on the academic 
job market for Fall 2026.

I received my B.S. in Mathematics from Lehigh University in 2021.

My research interests lie in **algebraic combinatorics**, particularly in the 
study of modified Macdonald polynomials, Catalan functions, and $k$-shapes. 
My work explores connections between algebraic structures and combinatorial 
objects.

I was born in Bangkok, Thailand, and moved to the United States at age 18. Outside of mathematics, I enjoy exploring food from different cultures, 
singing, music, interested in stock technical analysis, chess, and playing the mobile game *Last War*.

---

## Research

My research focuses on algebraic combinatorics, with an emphasis on symmetric 
functions and related combinatorial structures.

Current interests include:

- Modified Macdonald polynomials
- Catalan functions
- $k$-shapes

My goal is to understand how algebraic structures encode meaningful 
combinatorial information and how these connections can lead to new results.
